text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was finally time for Curren Chan's Make Debut.
Assuming she'd naturally be nervous at first, I went to speak to her, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Um, the heart-pounding pose goes like...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Something like this, maybe?
With this—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so mean!
You think I'm lying just to get your attention?
choice_data_list: It's not that I think you're lying, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so nervous.
I mean, this is where
Curren's path begins.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The path to mastering 'cuteness' is...
Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan smiles cutely.
She's definitely nervous...
or rather, there's a mysterious air of tension around her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it about time?
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's Make Debut♪
Shall we get started?
